'''November 2000 Parker tournament (18 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 18 November 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1469">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-18-parker-co-11-18-00-back-in-actiond1469/ parker-co-11-18-00-back-in-action], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 18 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-18-parker-co-11-18-00-back-in-actiond1469/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
